info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Collections API
info.description: The Manage Collections API enables businesses to modify existing collections in their collateral management systems. With the PATCH operation, users can update details related to a specific collection identified by its unique collectionId. This API is essential for financial institutions and organizations that need to maintain accurate collateral records. Typical consumers include banking professionals and system integrators who manage asset-backed securities and collateral transactions. Streamlining and customizing collection data is crucial for compliance and operational efficiency.

patch.description: This operation allows the user to update the details of a specific collateral collection identified by RES-100045. Ensure all required fields are provided to successfully execute the update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the specified collateral administration collection with the given identifier. It should contain the necessary fields to modify the existing collection properties according to the requirements.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred while processing the request.

422.description: The request was well-formed but unable to be followed due to semantic errors.
